home.title: Find practical help you can rely on
home.eyebrow: Public information and shared tools for Calais
home.description: See what help is available, where and when. Each published activity names the responsible organisation and shows when the information was checked.
home.searchPlaceholder: What do you need? e.g. food, shower, doctor
home.activitiesDescription: Filter services and see exact public locations in a low-data map.
home.urgentBody: The shortest route to the most needed information.
home.openNowBody: Recurring activities run by verified associations. Each card shows the current status and how fresh the information is.
home.servicesBody: Choose a service to see every place that offers it.
home.articlesDescription: Read dated information with a clear factual owner and review status.
home.guideDescription: Answer optional questions one at a time. Your answers are never stored.
home.associationsBody: Every piece of information belongs to a named, verified organisation responsible for keeping it accurate.
home.trustBody: Five values shape how information is published, accessed and maintained, and how organisations work together.
home.valueDignityBody: Read public information without an account or a profile of the help you view or receive.
home.valueReliabilityBody: See who is responsible, when information was checked and when you should confirm before travelling.
home.valueAccessibilityBody: Use clear information across devices, connection speeds, languages, layouts and literacy levels.
home.valueCollaborationBody: Give associations a shared place to publish, coordinate events and reduce duplicated work.
home.valueResponsibilityBody: Keep an owner and a history for each published claim, correction and approval.
home.metaDescription: Find reviewed practical information in Calais, see when it was checked and identify the organisation responsible.
